name: Outcome first, detail after
rule: Open with the result or status, then give the supporting detail beneath it for people who want it.

leaders.note: Puts the current value above the trend chart so people get the answer first. The Dashboard home uses the same order: headline figure, then the chart.
Each notification starts from a status, such as success for a completed task. Task-triggered messages stay short, with the status first and context only when needed.
Modal body copy states the main consequence first, in one to three sentences. Any further detail follows.
